submitted_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near healthcare services.

scenario_definition.name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: Senior Residential Care (RSA)
scenario_definition.initial_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find a hotel building to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA) for 30 residents in Turin with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.

clarifications.I: I am looking for a hotel building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA).
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 30 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near healthcare services.

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Energy class is used because the user did not mention consumption. Healthcare proximity and the hotel-to-RSA conversion are not energy requirements and are excluded.
User wants the hotel to be near healthcare services for a residential senior care facility (RSA). 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on energy_class (A1 through D) and healthcare score >= 75. The extracted typology requirement references tipologia_bene_immobile, which is not in filterable_columns, so it was ignored per the allowlist rule (property_type is the filterable equivalent, but it was not supplied as a requirement). No lat/lon was provided, so results are ordered by id ASC.
